title: XXXI. Of the one Oblation of Chriſt, finiſhed upon the Croſs.

segments.text: THe Offering of Chriſt once made, is that perfect Redemption, Propitiation, and Satisfaction for all the ſins of the whole world, both Original and Actual, and there is none other Satisfaction for ſin, but that alone. Wherefore the Sacrifices of Maſſes, in the which it was commonly ſaid, that the Prieſt did offer Chriſt for the quick and the dead, to have Remiſſion of pain or guilt, were blaſphemous Fables and dangerous Deceits.
